# BB00278 {.unnumbered}

In the Name of God, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate

God beareth witness that there is none other God but Him, and the angels and those endowed with knowledge, standing firm on justice, bear witness that there is none other God but Him, the Almighty, the All-Wise.

O God! I beseech Thee by Thy oneness, O Thou besides Whom there is none other God, to forgive me through Thy words There is none other God but Thee, for this is a mighty day and Thou art the sovereign, the creator, the generous one.

Grant unto me and unto all who have believed in Thee and Thy signs that which befitteth the wonders of Thy mercy, the loftiness of Thy grace and the sublimity of Thy gifts. I beseech Thee in this day, and in the days before it and after it, to ordain for me and for all who have believed in Thee all that Thou hast ordained for Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, through that which Thy knowledge hath encompassed of Thy bounty and which Thy book hath numbered of Thy mercy. Verily Thou art the most bountiful of the bountiful, and verily Thou art the most merciful of the merciful.

Praise be to God Who hath taken unto Himself no son, Who hath no partner in His dominion, nor any protector out of weakness. And magnify Him with all magnificence.
